params._about: Solo-tuned AI stats for the Skyglass treasure hunts (engine/hunts.ts). Keys are live AI ids; pools = poolsMultiplier, rows = innate +100% damage-given rows (each capped at 100 by the engine, rows multiply), stats = statsMultiplier where changed from live. Crown Archivist (Archive alarm guard) and the Called to the Archive summon (Crown Stonebound: echoHp, echoPower) per RUL-2026-10-28-013.
params._final_pass: fable/skyglass-final-sim: Watch Captain 2/4 -> 2.5/1 + 10% givenDown (the phase-1 duel killed a solo player by round 3-9: 7/40); Foundry Warden 2.5/1 -> 3.5/1 (97.5% -> target 80%); Cache Sentinel 3/3 -> 3/4 (RUL-2026-10-28-021: boss ~20% HP); echoPower 60 -> 40 (RUL-2026-10-28-026 item 3).

record.name: Spreading Fire I
record.description: The Arsenal Keeper touches off the powder store; embers on these rows burn whoever acts on them.
record.battleDescription: %user strikes the powder store. Fire catches the far planks.

record.name: Spreading Fire II
record.description: The Arsenal Keeper touches off the powder store; embers on these rows burn whoever acts on them.
record.battleDescription: %user feeds the fire. It spreads down the deck.

record.name: Spreading Fire III
record.description: The Arsenal Keeper touches off the powder store; embers on these rows burn whoever acts on them.
record.battleDescription: %user lets the magazine burn. Only the gangway is clear.

record.name: Crate Swing
record.description: Swings a looted crate. The same steady hit every time.

record.name: Cutlass Slash
record.description: A looter's cutlass. The same hard cut every time.
record.battleDescription: %user slashes at %target with a notched cutlass.

record.name: Pocket a Ration
record.description: Once a fight, at half health, he eats a pocketed ration and can't fall this round.
record.battleDescription: %user stuffs a pocketed ration in his mouth. He won't fall this round.

record.name: Hand Out a Ration
record.description: Feeds one looter beside him: it can't fall this round and heals a little.
record.battleDescription: %user hands %target a ration. %target won't fall this round.

record.name: Count Out a Ration
record.description: Alone, he counts out a ration for himself. He eats it next turn.
record.battleDescription: %user counts out a ration for himself. He'll eat it next turn.

record.name: Eat a Ration
record.description: Eats the ration he counted out: he can't fall this round and heals a little.
record.battleDescription: %user eats his ration. He won't fall this round.

record.name: Count the Stores
record.description: A slow, heavy hit. Each count makes the next few hit harder.
record.battleDescription: %user counts the stores out loud and brings the ledger down on %target.

record.name: Stack the Crates
record.description: Stacks looted crates into a wall in front of the crew.

record.name: Open the Stores
record.description: Opens the stores: every looter around him is fed this round.
record.battleDescription: %user opens the stores. Every looter in the room is fed and won't fall this round.

record.name: Up from the Hold
record.description: Calls a deckhand up from the hold.
record.battleDescription: %user bangs on the hatch. A deckhand climbs up from the hold.
